AI column: every Azure and Google AI service, per app

Before: one short label per app ("Azure OpenAI", "OpenAI + Gemini"). After: the AI cell lists every model the app calls, grouped by where it runs. Gathered from each repo's source on 2026-11-03: appsettings, option classes and client code, with tests and vendored libraries excluded.

What moved

  1. LIST Each AI cell is grouped under Azure, Google and In-app (models running inside the app or browser, with no paid service).
  2. HINT Every model name is a hint: hover, tap or focus it to see what the app uses it for, for example "Judges the fight, rewrites personas and fact-checks claims with web search".
  3. OPTIONAL Models wired in the code but off by default are greyed and marked "optional": PoMode's interpreter, PoWatch's recaps, PoSeeReview's Gemini remaster, PoRedoMedia's Google features, and PoFightJudge's Gemini fallback.
  4. WRAPS AI is the one column that wraps (15–19rem). Every other cell stays one line.
  5. FIX The pinned app column now fills the whole row height when the row is tall. A grid on the table cell had stopped it stretching.
